headline: A $2 special dividend (2.4% of the price) moves cash to holders; the stock drops by it on the ex-date
reasoning: Source: Warrior Met Coal's announcement, relayed by Benzinga Newsdesk 08:42 ET (headline only): 'Warrior Met Coal Declares Special Dividend Of $2 Per Share'.
What changed: $2 a share leaves the balance sheet and goes to holders. Against the 83.45 close that is 2.4%, and the price adjusts mechanically on the ex-date. Pre-market: no IEX trades.
